name: SpotDraft — Contract Sent for Signature notifier

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: SELECT Id, Name, SpotDraft_ID__c, Status__c, Account__r.Name, Opportunity__r.Name, Contract_Link__c, LastModifiedDate FROM SpotDraft_Contract__c WHERE Status__c IN ('Signing','Awaiting Signature') AND LastModifiedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:1 ORDER BY LastModifiedDate DESC

nodes.name: SF: signature-stage contracts
nodes.notes: Pulls SpotDraft contracts currently in Signing / Awaiting Signature that changed in the last day. The Code node dedups so each contract notifies only once.

nodes.name: Post to #sfdc-oppty-audit
nodes.notes: One message per newly-signature contract. The bot must be a member of #sfdc-oppty-audit with chat:write.
